description: Small candidate set, not an exhaustive search. First candidate is the default. One warp owns each WM-by-WN output tile; the block shape is (BN/(TN*WNITER), BM/(TM*WMITER)), with WMITER=WM*WN/(32*TM*TN*WNITER), and thread count is derived as 32*(BM/WM)*(BN/WN). Historical results used a separate THREADS parameter and remain archived unchanged; these candidates require validation with the current implementation.
